title: Repère RCA golden record
description: One evaluation item for the OOI Regional Cabled Array agent suite. Two record shapes share a common envelope: shape A (text) carries a reference output; shape B (tool-using) carries a tool allowlist, input files, a sandbox spec and a deterministic checker. The verification tier is an explicit field and drives which scoring block is required (see validate.py for the cross-field rules the schema cannot express).

id.description: Stable id: rca-<family>-<slug>-<NNN>. Never reused after retirement.

family.description: Agent family from the whiteboard: 1 coding agent, 2 lit-review agent, 3 sensor agent.

group.description: Task group from the whiteboard. 1a-1d belong to family coding; 2 to litreview; 3 to sensor.

tier.description: How correctness is established. T1: scored against an independently measured physical quantity with an oracle solver. T2: deterministic checker on the execution result of generated code. T3: retrieval and attribution scored against a date-bounded reference corpus. T4: expert rubric; judge scores reportable only after inter-rater agreement and judge calibration.

shape.description: A: prompt + reference output text. B: prompt + {tools, input files} + task, with a deterministic checker.

status.description: template = authored by an assistant as a skeleton and NOT ground truth; draft = a co-author is writing it; verified = a second person checked the gold against the source; frozen = included in a released suite version; retired = no longer used (keep the file).

prompt.description: The exact user message handed to the agent. Must not contain the answer, the checker logic, or gold identifiers.

author.description: Person (or 'assistant-template') who wrote the prompt and gold.

author_role.description: e.g. PI, postdoc, OOI data team, RCA engineer.

source.description: Where the item comes from: repo path, catalog entry id, paper DOI, OOI annotation id, personal expertise. Be specific enough that a reviewer can open it.

source_ref.description: Commit hash, DOI, URL, or issue number pinning the source.

method.description: What the verifier did: reran the oracle, opened the paper, queried M2M on date X, cross-checked FDSN station service.

construction.description: How this item survives the retrieval-corpus leakage problem. none: item is not derived from the agent's corpus. catalog_perturbed: the gold differs from the catalog entry by a verified perturbation (e.g. a deployment date the catalog has wrong or omits). catalog_excluded: the referenced instrument or paper is removed from the corpus snapshot the agent sees for this item. cross_source_join: the answer requires joining the catalog with a source not in the corpus (M2M deployments, FDSN metadata, chronfix). temporal_after_index: the item concerns content published after the corpus snapshot date. paraphrase_only: the prompt is a paraphrase and the gold is a catalog field verbatim; this construction is NOT holdout-safe and is allowed only for validation/public. held_out_site: the item's site is excluded from the corpus entirely.

leakage_note.description: Why the chosen construction defeats a copy-from-corpus solver for this item.

canary.description: Canary GUID embedded in private items to detect training-set scraping.

cutoff_date.description: Date past which retrieval tools must not return content. Required (non-null) for T3 and for any item whose agent has a corpus tool; null only for items with no retrieval surface.

corpus_snapshot.description: Pin of the retrieval corpus the agent is allowed to see for this item.

snapshot_ref.description: Commit hash or manifest sha256 of the snapshot.

excluded_ids.description: Corpus ids removed from the agent's view for this item (catalog_excluded construction).

reference_output.description: Shape A only. The reference answer text, or a structured reference (e.g. list of expected citation ids with roles).

reference_citations.description: Shape A, T3 only. Corpus ids that a correct answer must cite (relevant set), each with a relevance grade.

grade.description: 0 not relevant (explicit negative), 1 marginal, 2 relevant, 3 essential.

allowlist.description: Registry names from repere.agents.registry (existing) plus the RCA additions (fdsn_get_stations, ooi_m2m_get, pi_portal_get, sensor_kb_search). The registry must reject any name not listed here.

inputs.description: Shape B only. Files mounted read-only into the sandbox work dir. Every file is pinned by sha256; the validator checks the hash when the file is present locally.

path.description: Path relative to the suite data root (public) or to REPERE_RCA_PRIVATE_DIR (private).

license.description: Required for anything not produced by the group; OOI data are public domain (CC0-like) per OOI data policy, verify per file.

task.description: Shape B only. What the agent must produce; consumed by the checker.

deliverable.description: script: the agent returns Python that the harness executes; artifact: the agent uses python_session and record_submit; script_and_artifact: both are scored.

artifact_keys.description: Keys the generated code must pass to record(...) (e.g. n_samples, sampling_rate_hz, clock_offset_s).

required_calls.description: Substrings that must appear in the code (weak, static check).

image.description: Fully qualified image name with tag.

image_digest.description: Immutable digest; tags move. Required before status=frozen.

network.description: none: no egress. replay: egress only to the harness replay proxy serving a recorded cassette. allowlist: live egress to the listed hosts only (record mode).

allowlist.description: Hosts permitted when network=allowlist, e.g. service.earthscope.org, ooinet.oceanobservatories.org.

cassette.description: Path of the recorded HTTP cassette used when network=replay.

oracle.description: T1 only. A deterministic solver that produces the reference from the inputs, plus the independent measurement it is validated against.

independent_measurement.description: What physical measurement the oracle is checked against (e.g. hourly cross-correlation peak lag vs HYS12) and where it lives.

checker.description: T2 only. Deterministic function over the sandbox ExecResult.

judge.description: T4 only. A judge score may be reported only when the agreement and calibration fields are filled and above threshold.

rubric_ref.description: Path to the pinned rubric markdown.

human_ratings_ref.description: Where the human ratings for this item live (private).

judge_model_pin.description: Exact judge model id; the judge is itself a pinned dependency.

calibration_set_ref.description: Items used to calibrate judge-vs-human agreement.

config.description: Method-specific extras, kept serialisable so a third party can rebuild the scorer.

photos.description: Family 3 only. Instrument imagery is never scraped; each entry records the licence and attribution required to show it.

todos.description: Specific questions a co-author must answer before status can advance past draft. Templates must have at least one. Verified/frozen records must have zero.
